item.title: Don Lemon taken into custody in Los Angeles in connection with Minnesota church protest: Reports
item.description: Former CNN anchor Don Lemon was taken into custody Friday following a protest inside a Minnesota church, according to reporting from The New York Times.

item.title: Fallen cables from elevated J line damage parked cars, slow subway service in Brooklyn
item.description: Fallen communication cables from elevated J line tracks blocked a Brooklyn street Friday morning, prompting an FDNY response and slowing subway service, according to the MTA.

item.title: Judge rules federal prosecutors can’t seek death penalty against Luigi Mangione
item.description: A federal judge in New York dismissed a federal murder charge against Luigi Mangione on Friday, ruling prosecutors cannot seek the death penalty in the case tied to the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.

item.title: NJ Transit delays today due to disabled Amtrak train stuck in Hudson River Tunnel
item.description: NJ TRANSIT rail service is facing delays of up to 60 minutes into and out of New York Penn Station after a disabled train in one of the Hudson River Tunnels, officials said.

item.title: Will snow hit or miss NYC? What to know for Nor'easter this weekend
item.description: Forecasters say a nor’easter this weekend could bring heavy snow to coastal New Jersey and parts of southern New England, while New York City remains near the storm’s western edge.

item.title: Meteorologist predictions for rest of winter in NYC
item.description: Should New York City expect six more weeks of winter, or an early spring? FOX 5 NY's chief meteorologist Nick Gregory breaks down what to expect in his 2026 mid-winter weather outlook.

item.title: NJ earthquake: 2.4 magnitude quake reported in New Jersey

item.title: New SNAP work requirements kick in for more states Feb. 1: What to know
item.description: New work requirements are starting in more states Sunday for Americans who receive Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits. Here’s what to know about the changes.New SNAP work requirementsThe massive tax cuts and spending bill signed into law in July by President Donald Trump added more requirements for many adult SNAP recipients to work, volunteer or participate in job training for at least 80 hours a month. item.title: Off-duty officer killed in DWI crash on Long Island: officials
item.description: A 20-year-old man was arrested after police say he was driving while intoxicated when he crashed into another vehicle, killing a local police officer.The victim, identified as 46-year-old Patricia Espinosa, was driving on Route 347 early Saturday morning when she was hit.She was transported to a local hospital, where she was pronounced dead.Police say the driver, 20-year-old Matthew Smith, ran a red light on Alexander Avenue before the fatal crash.Smith was charged with driving while intoxicated
